items: Ollama Cloud no longer has a free cloud tier (pay-as-you-go per token).
Added Hetzner Inference API (free while experimental).
Added Lightning AI Model APIs (signup credits).
Added Tencent EdgeOne Makers Models (500K free tokens/month on 9 built-in models).
NaraRouter Free plan cut from 3 models to 1 (laguna-s-2.1); still 7M tokens/day, 15 RPM.
BazaarLink free models down from 7 to 6.
NaraRouter free models cut from 5 to 3 (still 7M tokens/day, 15 RPM).
Rechecked Infron, Token Harbor and AMD Token Factory docs.
Added GW BUS, EURI by Euron, APIBridge, rout.my.
APInex free allowance cut from 10M to 3M tokens/day.
Added Aion Labs, Frenix, MixRoute, Bay of Assets / Routeriva.
Added Router9, Ramp Router, Bytez, ModelScope API-Inference.
Added OpenCode Zen, Electron Hub, Pollinations.
BazaarLink free list grew from 2 to 7 models.
Added Vikasit AI, xKiro, BlazeAPI, CrowLLM.
Added AIHubMix, Routeway, Clean APIs, Agnes AI, AMD Radeon Cloud Token Factory, Vercel AI Gateway.
Hugging Face free monthly credits ended; SambaNova Free needs card + purchase; Fireworks signup credit removed.
NaraRouter free models cut from 10 to 5.
Added FreeTheAI, Requesty, Kilo Gateway, OVHcloud AI Endpoints.
Added Gonka Broker, FreeAIapikey, Vireonix, Infron, Token Harbor.
APInex free rate dropped to 5 RPM per IP.
Added DreamPrompting, LLM7.io, AnyAPI, Y-API daily key.

Initial list: Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, Cloudflare, SambaNova, Mistral, Z.ai, Cohere, Hugging Face, SiliconFlow, Ollama Cloud, Cerebras, Fireworks, Alibaba Model Studio, Google Cloud express mode, Anthropic, APInex.

sites.name: Gemini API (Google AI Studio)
sites.free_allowance: Free tier on selected Gemini models
sites.limits: Per-model RPM/RPD on Google's rate-limit page
sites.notes: Free-tier prompts may be used to improve Google products.

sites.name: Groq
sites.notes: Limits vary by model.

sites.name: OpenRouter
sites.notes: Free-model providers may log prompts.

sites.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
sites.notes: Allowance is in Neurons; token equivalent depends on model.

sites.name: SambaNova Cloud
sites.notes: Since 15 Oct the Free plan requires a card and a purchase.

sites.name: Cohere
sites.notes: Trial keys are for non-production use.

sites.name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
sites.notes: Free monthly Inference credits ended (reported 15 Oct).

sites.name: NVIDIA Build / NIM
sites.notes: Models include Kimi K3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM 5.3.

sites.name: Ollama Cloud
sites.free_allowance: No free cloud tier: pay-as-you-go per token ($0 plan); local use free
sites.notes: Pricing page lists every cloud model with per-token prices.

sites.name: Cerebras
sites.notes: Trial only, card required, 30 days.

sites.name: Fireworks AI
sites.notes: Signup credit removed (reported 15 Oct).

sites.name: Google Cloud Vertex AI express mode
sites.notes: Not OpenAI compatible (Vertex/Gemini API).

sites.name: Anthropic API
sites.notes: OpenAI SDK compatibility layer; no free daily allowance published.

sites.name: APInex
sites.notes: Cut from 10M to 3M/day on 23 Oct. Free models: free/gpt-6-luna, free/deepseek-v4.1-flash, free/gemini-3.8-flash. Paid 10/20/30-day plans. Model names are its own catalogue labels.

sites.name: NaraRouter
sites.notes: Free plan now only laguna-s-2.1 (cut 10→5 on 14 Oct, 5→3 on 26 Oct, 3→1 on 28 Oct). Also Anthropic compatible.

sites.name: Free.ai
sites.notes: Self-hosted models like Qwen 2.5.

sites.name: BazaarLink
sites.notes: Free list grew from 2 to 7 models on 20 Oct, now 6 (28 Oct). Limits shared across free models, resets 00:00 UTC.

sites.name: YepAPI
sites.notes: One-time credit.

sites.name: TokenFaucet
sites.free_allowance: Daily token lucky draw (amount not published)
sites.notes: Third-party relay; genuinely free models mainly MiMo and MiniMax. Also Anthropic compatible.

sites.name: DreamPrompting
sites.notes: Still 500K/day on 16 Oct.

sites.name: LLM7.io
sites.notes: Still 100K/24h on 16 Oct.

sites.name: AnyAPI
sites.notes: Allowance is in ANY Tokens.

sites.name: Y-API daily shared key
sites.notes: Shared public key; reseller.

sites.name: Gonka Broker
sites.notes: Renews on the 1st of each month.

sites.name: Vireonix
sites.free_allowance: No key needed; hourly fair use
sites.notes: Keyless.

sites.name: Infron
sites.notes: Standard free models need a $5+ balance (not consumed).

sites.name: Token Harbor
sites.notes: Free-model prompts may be retained. Also Anthropic compatible.

sites.name: TrustedRouter
sites.notes: One-time grant.

sites.name: Batchrate
sites.notes: Files/Batches API only.

sites.name: ParalonCloud
sites.notes: Unlock via X/GitHub/Discord.

sites.name: AIHubMix
sites.notes: 10 trial calls before top-up.

sites.name: Clean APIs
sites.notes: Young domain.

sites.name: AMD Radeon Cloud Token Factory
sites.free_allowance: Free models with a daily points cap
sites.notes: China site only; dev/trial use, not production.

sites.name: xKiro
sites.free_allowance: 500K tokens/day (1M/day with Telegram verify), 40+ free models
sites.notes: Also a one-off 30M bonus for 30 days after Telegram verification.

sites.name: Onomeo
sites.notes: Beta; free answers carry a 'via onomeo.com' line.

sites.name: LLM Gateway
sites.free_allowance: Zero-priced free models, no credits needed
sites.notes: Verified email needed.

sites.name: Electron Hub
sites.free_allowance: 10 requests/day on :free models (up to 200 with ads) + $0.25 weekly credit

sites.name: Router9
sites.notes: Free-tier models only.

sites.name: Ramp Router
sites.notes: Responses API only, no Chat Completions.

sites.name: Bytez
sites.notes: Open models up to 7B.

sites.name: ModelScope API-Inference
sites.notes: Needs Alibaba Cloud real-name verification.

sites.name: Aion Labs
sites.notes: Roleplay models.

sites.name: Frenix
sites.notes: Telegram sign-in.

sites.name: Bay of Assets / Routeriva
sites.notes: Standard text models.

sites.name: GW BUS
sites.free_allowance: $5 signup credit + 1M tokens/day on Free plan
sites.notes: 50+ models; new, little-known gateway.

sites.name: EURI by Euron
sites.notes: Plus plan: 100,000/day.

sites.name: APIBridge
sites.notes: Operator unknown.

sites.name: Flexlora
sites.notes: Looks like a NaraRouter rebrand/reseller.

sites.name: Inception (Mercury)
sites.notes: One-time grant for new accounts.

sites.name: Experiential Labs
sites.free_allowance: 1M tokens/day shared on free core models (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GPT-6 Luna, Clef)
sites.notes: One-time $1 card check needed for free models (credited back as balance). Also Anthropic Messages and Responses API.

sites.name: Runcrate
sites.free_allowance: Free usage on 5 open models (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM 5.3, GLM 5.3 Flash, gpt-oss 120B, Qwen3.8 Flash)
sites.limits: Session cap plus weekly allowance (resets Monday); sizes unpublished
sites.notes: Needs a GitHub account at least 30 days old. Free requests served by third-party providers.

sites.name: InferAll
sites.free_allowance: 25 free calls, then 25 calls/day free on 10+ NVIDIA NIM open models
sites.limits: 25 calls/day (50 chat/day after one-time $5 starter pack)
sites.notes: Also Anthropic compatible at https://api.inferall.ai. Run by Kindly Robotics.

sites.name: Flux Router
sites.free_allowance: $1 of usage per month on the Free plan
sites.notes: Smart-routing gateway (flux-auto), 78+ models, also Anthropic compatible.

sites.name: River AI (River Inference)
sites.notes: Credit announced by CEO Igor Babuschkin on X on 11 Oct 2026 for sign-ups 'right now'; not on the pricing page, may have ended. Models include DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM-5.3 Flash.

sites.name: Tencent EdgeOne Makers Models
sites.limits: 300 s max per request; rate limits on abuse
sites.notes: Built-in models: @makers/hy3, hy3-preview, deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek-v4-flash, deepseek-v4.1-flash, minimax-m3, minimax-m2.7, kimi-k2.6, zhuque-text. Not for production. Also BYOK for OpenAI/Anthropic/Google etc. with no platform fee. Anthropic compatible too.

sites.name: Typhoon API (OpenTyphoon)
sites.free_allowance: Free tier on Typhoon models (light usage)
sites.notes: Thai-first models: typhoon-v2.5-30b-a3b-instruct, typhoon-v2.1-12b-instruct; also OCR and ASR APIs. Key from Typhoon Playground.

sites.name: SenseNova Token Plan
sites.free_allowance: Free public-beta Token Plan: shared credit pool across Kimi K3, GLM-5.2, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and SenseNova models
sites.limits: Credits per rolling 5 hours and per week (reported 120K/5h and 1.2M/week since 27 Oct); credits, not tokens
sites.notes: Also Anthropic Messages compatible. Credit pool figures from third-party trackers; official page is JS-only.

sites.name: PEKPIK LLM
sites.free_allowance: $1 on email verify, then one daily claim (up to $20 over first 40 days, continues after)
sites.limits: 10 requests/min on free tier; daily claim resets balance, no stacking
sites.notes: Multi-model gateway; one permanent key.

sites.name: Aevon
sites.free_allowance: $100 free credits on signup via GitHub; 3 Free Tier models
sites.notes: Gateway on Venice AI infra, has its own crypto token; also Anthropic base URL. Treat as prototype-only.

sites.name: Api.Airforce
sites.free_allowance: Free plan $0/month on basic models (e.g. gpt-oss-20b)
sites.notes: Multi-model gateway, 100+ models on paid plans.

sites.name: Infercom (SambaNova EU)
sites.free_allowance: €5 free API credit on signup (expires after 90 days)
sites.limits: Standard free-plan rate limits (see docs.infercom.ai rate limits)
sites.notes: EU-hosted SambaNova Cloud service; production models only on Free.

sites.name: AI21 Labs (Jamba)
sites.notes: Jamba Mini and Jamba Large; chat completions in an OpenAI-like format via AI21 SDK.

sites.name: Tencent Cloud TokenHub
sites.free_allowance: 1M free tokens per language model, one-time, valid 1 year (campaign until 31 Dec 2026)
sites.notes: Each model claim freezes $10 of account balance or credit limit, returned when endpoints are deleted.

sites.name: Helyx AI
sites.free_allowance: $10 signup credit (one-time) on any listed model
sites.notes: Third-party aggregator listings say $2 is instant and $8 is released by support; daily free-token claims are mentioned but no figure is published on the official site. Crypto top-ups.

sites.name: JoinGonka Gateway
sites.free_allowance: 3M one-time starter tokens after email confirmation
sites.limits: Models: GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, MiniMax-M2.7; then pay per token
sites.notes: Also Anthropic-format at https://gate.joingonka.ai. One-time bonus, not a daily quota.

sites.name: ngrok.ai AI Gateway
sites.limits: ngrok-managed keys cover OpenAI and Anthropic models; credits otherwise prepaid (min $5)
sites.card_required: No card stated for the $1 credit
sites.notes: Sign in at app.ngrok.ai. Bring-your-own-key also supported.

sites.name: nabh.cloud
sites.free_allowance: Free plan: 50 credits (₹50) on signup, then 50 every month; GPT OSS 20B only
sites.notes: Indian prepaid LLM marketplace billed in rupees; top-ups via UPI from ₹500

sites.name: Mervex
sites.free_allowance: Free key: 100 requests/day plus one-time +400 welcome bonus (per the team's 3 Nov launch post)
sites.limits: Extra daily quota for linking Discord/Google/GitHub
sites.notes: Small bootstrapped gateway on a free subdomain, 100+ open models (Gemma, Llama, Qwen, GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek)

sites.name: Orq AI Gateway
sites.limits: Pay as you go after the credit; 500+ models
sites.notes: EU-hosted gateway, one key for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral and more

sites.name: OpenAny
sites.free_allowance: $0.50 signup credit (homepage; launch post said $1), does not expire
sites.limits: Prepaid pay-per-call after the credit; ~154 models plus data APIs
sites.card_required: No card for the signup credit
sites.notes: Launched October 2026

sites.name: Hetzner Inference API (Experiments)
sites.free_allowance: Free of charge while the API is experimental; models Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 and Qwen3.8-27B
sites.limits: Per key per 60s: 10 requests, 4M input tokens, 100K output tokens; no daily token cap published
sites.notes: Needs a Hetzner account; create a token at experiments.hetzner.com. Not for production; no availability guarantee.

sites.name: Lightning AI Model APIs
sites.free_allowance: 5 free credits on signup (25 more if you add a card); docs say up to 40M free tokens to start; credits expire after 12 months
sites.notes: One key across GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, GLM and more. Personal-email accounts can take 1-3 days to activate.

sites.name: OpenPaths
sites.free_allowance: Free models bill $0 per token (OpenRouter :free routes plus OpenPaths Free and others); paid models need credits
sites.limits: Best-effort rate limits per key; tokens/day unspecified
sites.notes: Open-source model router. Free catalogue lists many or/*:free models plus nvidia/deepseek-v4-flash and openpaths/free. No card for free routes.

sites.name: LLM EU
sites.free_allowance: $5 promotional inference credit per new organisation; expires in 90 days; one grant per org
sites.notes: European catalogue/router. Partner endpoints (including OpenRouter rows) may need policy turn-on. Card payments not enabled on this deployment.

sites.name: Boundless API
sites.free_allowance: $5 signup bonus (Starter model pool); may expire after 30 days if unused
sites.limits: Starter pool rate limits; tokens/day unspecified
sites.notes: Unified router for Claude/GPT/Gemini and curated models. Billing policy also notes a 5% platform fee on credit purchases after the bonus.

sites.name: Mango Inference
sites.free_allowance: $10 free credits on signup (launch offer); 30% off models through 11 Nov 2026
sites.limits: Tokens/day unspecified; credits expire after stated validity period
sites.notes: MangoBoost first-party OpenAI-compatible (and Anthropic Messages) API for open-weight models such as DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM-5.3, Kimi-K3. Korean infrastructure.

sites.name: LLMCloud
sites.free_allowance: $1 free credits on signup; no card required
sites.notes: One OpenAI-compatible key across 150+ models with auto:cost / auto:quality / auto:reasoning routing. Signup page states free $1 credit.

sites.name: Nscale
sites.free_allowance: $5 free starter credit for new accounts (stated in docs changelog for Serverless Inference and Fine-tuning); quickstart says early users may be eligible
sites.notes: UK AI cloud OpenAI-compatible serverless inference. Google SSO signup. Confirm free credit still appears in console on signup.

sites.name: Maritaca AI (S5-free)
sites.free_allowance: S5-free model: no token charge for a limited launch window (text only; no Batch/Flex/built-in tools)
sites.limits: S5-free: 60 RPM, 256K TPM in, 256K TPM out (fixed across tiers)
sites.notes: Brazilian Sabiá/S5 API. Official pricing docs (maritalk-api) document S5-free as temporary. Paid S5 remains available when free ends. Base URL from Maritaca API docs / community examples.

sites.name: EXAONE API Platform (LG K-EXAONE 2.5)
sites.free_allowance: K-EXAONE 2.5 API free to use with an API key (announced 9 Nov 2026); no quota published
sites.notes: Official LG AI Research. Model k-exaone_v2.5, 512K context, Korean/English text only. Rate limits and end date not published.

sites.name: Regolo.ai
sites.free_allowance: 30-day free trial, 1M tokens/day on all Core models
sites.notes: Italian EU hosting. Trial ends after 30 days, then pay-as-you-go. Model multipliers affect how fast the daily allowance is used.

sites.name: FreeInference (Harvard MadSys Lab)
sites.free_allowance: Free for research/education, 'generous' quota, tokens/day unpublished
sites.notes: Email signup. OpenAI and Anthropic compatible endpoints. Research lab, so avoid private data.

sites.name: Inferbase
sites.free_allowance: Free plan: 5,000 requests/month, 100 managed requests and $0.50 model usage/day on models up to $2/M output tokens
sites.limits: 60 RPM per key, 10 RPM managed, 8,192 in / 1,024 out tokens per request
sites.notes: Gateway with smart routing; tokens/day unspecified (daily cap is in dollars).
